Population increased in Walsall

The estimated population of Walsall in 2024 was 295,678 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that Walsall's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Walsall increased by 4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Walsall was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Walsall

The average (median) age fell to 38.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Walsall has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Walsall is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Walsall's population of 295,678 usual residents was made up of:

  • 63,682 people aged 0 to 15 years, (21.5%)
  • 181,408 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.4%)
  • 50,588 people aged 65 years and over, (17.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Walsall has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (21.5% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Walsall, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Walsall
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Walsall, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 538 people (0.2%). In total, there were 3,425 births and 2,887 deaths in Walsall.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 371 (-0.1%). There were 15,977 people entering the area and 16,348 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Walsall's population of 4,293 (1.5%) as a result of 5,497 people entering the area and 1,204 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Walsall was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Walsall in mid-2023 is 291,237.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,056 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 445 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,501 people.
